LanguageData.EI_BratCloak.label: brat cloak
LanguageData.EI_BratCloak.description: A heavy rectangular cloak worn over everyday clothing, inspired by the early medieval Irish brat. Cheap and quick to make, it provides strong cold-weather insulation when made from wool. Cloth is adequate, while linen sacrifices much of its warmth. It offers little protection from weapons or heat.
